scope: scripts/qualify_cax_import.py on a frozen Debug build of 2878f76 (D:\wp\b48), 35/35 steps, in an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1: an S7-300 CPU 315-2 PN/DP device is added, exported with cax_export and removed again by restoring its checkpoint; cax_import with RetainTiaDevice then brings it back from the retained AML with checkpoint, device compile and save, asserted preview (the Host-resolved AML path and hash) and change_status; the complete state differs from the device-free state only below the imported device, whose hardware rows equal the exported device's exactly; the first import restored from its checkpoint equals the device-free state; the second import persists through a fresh owned Portal reopen.
